No separate feature/proof contract or proof map is consumed. Historical routing, generic aliases, other location kinds and record safety remain outside retirement.

Unknown protective value blocks deletion, group-level removal accounting and actual discovery are required, and coherent rollback names the recoverable baseline while preserving customer and historical bytes. This avoids both automatic deletion by filename and unnecessary per-test ledgers.

Allocated validation is concrete at appropriate boundaries: public old-format rejection plus direct no-read observation; current models/catalogs and actual selector/executor Git selection; CLI unknown spec kind before discovery with retained-kind control; independent reduced manifest oracle, unknown-first safety and actual archive/packed installation for both targets. All nine named command paths exist, --check flags exist, and native boundary and packaging entrypoints collect their actual groups. No future command execution is claimed.

Its stale-authority/helper-retry living-model packet and omitted-authority, invented-record, Cartesian and wrong-owner counterexamples can distinguish weakened guidance. Closeout is sound: selected full local integration with honest reuse, release communication without publication authority, independent M1 review, fresh final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain separate. Exact committed PR selection/current-record snapshot and hosted/local limits are allocated. No other material allocation or authority gap was identified.
